page_title: MON 0-3 STU | B. Monchengladbach v Stuttgart 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Stuttgart spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
90+3' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
90+1' Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by the defence.
87' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Here is a change. Philipp Sander is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Substitution. Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Lukas Ullrich.
85' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is booked.
84' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Moritz Nicolas easily deals with the threat.

82' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
80' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 0:4.
79' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Angelo Stiller and he is replaced by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart).
79' The substitution is prepared. Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nikolas Nartey.
77' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
74' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Florian Neuhaus.
74' 0 - 3 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
73' Ramon Hendriks goes off the pitch and Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
71' 6:14 – the total goal attempt statistics.
69' Stuttgart are seeing far more of the ball now.
67' 0 - 2 What an unlucky own goal by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach)!
67' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.
66' Chance! Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
65' Eugen Polanski prepares a substitution. Franck Honorat is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
65' Substitution. Alejo Sarco (B. Monchengladbach) has come on for Rocco Reitz.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
63' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Stuttgart for a penalty. Play continues.
62' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
61' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Ermedin Demirovic.
60' The game has come to an end for Jamie Leweling. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).

59' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
58' Soren Storks blows his whistle after Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Stuttgart.
57' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
54' The ball possession is 44:56.
52' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.
50' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A pass from Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by Alexander Nubel and the move breaks down.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
40' The Stuttgart players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
38' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Moritz Nicolas makes a comfortable save.
36' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:1.
34' B. Monchengladbach keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
32' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Soren Storks blows for a foul.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
27' The game is interrupted. One of the players from B. Monchengladbach is cautioned for aggressive play.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:3.

23' That didn't go as planned! Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alexander Nubel, who easily kept it out.
22' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
20' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

19' Stuttgart are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
17' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' 61:39 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
13' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the left side of the target, but Alexander Nubel pulls off a superb save.
12' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is going to take the penalty!
11' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart). B. Monchengladbach are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
10' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
8' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Stuttgart are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
4' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
3' B. Monchengladbach are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
